name: 31548 · Kingsland, GA
findings: ZIP 31548 (Kingsland) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31548 (Kingsland) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 31548 (Kingsland) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
